info.title: BoxCompute Customer Sandbox API
info.description: The public customer contract for /api/v2. This is not the private downstream Sandbox API.
info.x-versioning-policy: Compatible fields and routes may be added within v2. Removing or changing existing behavior requires a new major path. Clients must ignore unknown response fields. SDK publication requires a versioned release generated from this document.

patch.summary: Atomically edit UTF-8 text when its SHA-256 precondition matches
patch.description: The edit commits as one atomic replacement only when expectedSha256 matches the complete current file. A stale hash returns PRECONDITION_FAILED without changing the file. Unless replaceAll is true, oldText must occur exactly once. Transport failure before a response leaves the outcome indeterminate; retry only after reading the file again.

get.summary: List one stable bounded page from an owned Sandbox directory
get.description: Entries use the Sandbox filesystem's stable native directory order. Pass nextCursor unchanged to continue. A directory membership mutation invalidates the cursor with CURSOR_STALE; child metadata can reflect its value when that page is read.

post.summary: Atomically rename a path in an owned Sandbox workspace
post.description: Source and destination must stay in the same Sandbox workspace and both parents must exist. By default an existing destination returns DESTINATION_EXISTS; overwrite atomically replaces it. A transport failure before a response leaves the outcome indeterminate, so inspect both paths before retrying.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Account-scoped replay key. Use 1–255 visible ASCII characters. Repeating the same canonical request within 24 hours replays the original response; using the key for a different public mutation returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
